messages:
maria (support): FYI customer reported a sharp increase in billed tokens + hanging requests after upgrading to redwood-python 1.9.0. They say requests never time out, retries keep firing. Rolling back to 1.8.x stops the behavior. Repro included below.

alex (sdk): Oof. Can you paste the minimal repro and the pip freeze from the customer's environment? Also which timeout param are they using (client vs per-call)?

maria (support): Repro (sanitized):
```python
# app.py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'], timeout=5)  # used to work in 1.8.x
resp = client.generate('hello')
print(resp.text)
```
Pip freeze snippet they sent:
```
redwood==1.9.0
requests==2.31.0
urllib3==1.26.15
python-dateutil==2.8.2
```
Customer logs (trim):
```
Request started: id=abc123
Waiting for response... (no timeout)
Retry triggered (attempt=2)
Retry triggered (attempt=3)
Billed tokens increased by 10x
```

alex (sdk): Thanks. This matches a regression we introduced in 1.9.0: the HTTP session pooling optimization accidentally set the session-level default timeout to None when a session is reused, and due to how we pass kwargs the per-client `timeout=` is swallowed for pooled sessions. Net effect: requests hang and automatic retry middleware keeps retrying because it never sees a socket timeout. It's not the same as the param-rename bug — it's an issue in the session re-use path.

alex (sdk): Workarounds until we patch: 1) Pin to 1.8.7: `pip install 'redwood==1.8.7'`  OR 2) set env: `RW_HTTP_SESSION_KEEPALIVE=false` which disables session reuse and preserves per-request timeout, OR 3) explicitly set a per-call `request_timeout` in the new call signature: `client.generate(..., request_timeout=5)` (this is an alternative interface that bypasses the pooled-default).

kevin (eng-runtime): Confirmed. We have a fix on branch `fix/session-timeout-regen` that restores honoring of client timeouts when a pooled session is used. PR GH#2421, internal ticket INC-2026-143. We're running CI and a canary deploy for the patch.

sam (sre): Customers experiencing spinning retries and billing spikes should be contacted with the pin + env workaround. I'll prepare an incident banner and targeted outreach for affected accounts. Any suggestion for phrasing?

maria (support): Draft message I've been using: "Hi — we identified a regression in redwood-python 1.9.0 that can cause requests to hang and trigger retries. Workaround: pin to 1.8.7 (`pip install 'redwood==1.8.7'`) or set `RW_HTTP_SESSION_KEEPALIVE=false`. A patch is being rolled out; we'll update you when it's live. Sorry for the disruption."

kevin (eng-runtime): That wording is good. ETA: hotfix build rolling to staging in ~40m, prod canary within 2 hours if staging looks good. Will post GH link when merged.

alex (sdk): After merge we'll publish a short note in the SDK changelog and add a migration note to the 1.9.0 release page describing the session pooling behavior and the env pin. Also adding an explicit deprecation warning in the next minor so `timeout=` doesn't get swallowed silently.

deploy-bot: build/fix-session-timeout-regen #2421 passed CI and was deployed to staging at 1768532900

sam (sre): Great. I'll queue the incident banner and send targeted emails to the accounts that reported spikes.

maria (support): Closing loop with customer now with the pin + env workaround. Will update thread if they confirm resolution after rollback. Thanks all.
